# FLX-2106: a replay produced a different run digest than the one asserted

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

`fluxsim replay --assert-digest <digest>` re-executes a recorded plan and compares the resulting runDigest against the digest given on the command line. A mismatch means the engine, the bundle, or the environment moved between the two runs -- `fluxsim verify` on the same run directory names which run-digest component moved.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2106
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
